<h2 id="一巡检与告警127">一、巡检与告警（1–27）</h2>
<p><strong>1. CN/DN SQL Digest 目录覆盖与更新时间</strong>——确认 CN、DN 两个来源是否有 SQL 摘要目录记录。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT schema_name, type AS source_type,
       COUNT(*) AS digest_entries,
       MAX(last_update_time) AS newest_catalog_update
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_sql_schema_static
GROUP BY schema_name, type
ORDER BY digest_entries DESC, schema_name
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>2. CN 在线事务时长与状态</strong>——查看 CN 上报的在线事务状态、时长和 SQL 数量。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, cn_id, uuid, gtid, trans_state, trans_type, execute_time, start_time, executed_sql_num, executing_sql_num
FROM goldendb_statistic.insight_cn_trans_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY execute_time DESC, cn_id LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>3. CN 消息状态采样</strong>——查看 CN 组件消息队列状态与线程描述。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, device_id, device_type, connect_port, cn_msg_queue_status, pname_info
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_cn_thdmsg
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, device_id LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>4. DN 在线事务与等待锁线索</strong>——定位 DN 在线事务、等待锁和潜在阻塞者。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, group_id, dn_id, trans_id, uuid, gtid, trans_state, trans_type, execute_time, start_time, requested_lock_id, wait_start_time, block_trans_id, blk_trx_count
FROM goldendb_statistic.insight_dn_trans_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY execute_time DESC, dn_id LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>5. DN 文件 I/O 等待历史采样排行</strong>——比较历史采样时点的文件 I/O 热点。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, Event_Name, time_stamp, Request_Read, Request_Write, Bytes_Read, Bytes_Write, Time_Read, Time_Write FROM goldendb_statistic.gdb_dn_iowait_orderedbytime_awr WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY Time_Read + Time_Write DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>6. DN 等待事件历史采样排行</strong>——回看等待事件次数、总等待与平均等待。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, events, time_stamp, waits, `time`, avg_wait_time FROM goldendb_statistic.gdb_dn_wait_orderbytime_awr WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY `time` DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>7. DN 等待会话及表刷新、元数据锁等待采样</strong>——分别展示等待表刷新和元数据锁的会话数。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, time_stamp, dn_session_waiting_for_count, dn_session_waiting_for_table_flush_count, dn_session_waiting_for_table_mdl_count FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_processlist WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>8. DN 锁冲突、缓冲区与 Redo 压力采样</strong>——同节点趋势线索，覆盖锁冲突率、脏页、命中率、临时表、Binlog 与 Redo。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, device_type, group_id, db_role, time_stamp,
       tablelock_conflictrate, rowlock_avgwaittime, buffer_dirtypagerate,
       buffer_hitrate, filetemptable_usedrate, binlogdisk_usedstat, redolog_waitstat
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_db_statistic
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>9. GTM 活跃 GTID 数与最大标识采样</strong>——观察全局事务标识变化。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, device_id, device_type, activegtid, maxgtid
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_gtm_gtidinfo
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, device_id LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>10. GTM 申请、释放与增量同步 GTID 平均耗时</strong>——定位分布式事务协调阶段的时间波动。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, time_stamp, gtidapplycost, gtidreleasecost, gtidincrementcost FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_gtmgtid_timecost WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>11. GTM 线程消息状态采样</strong>——查看 GTM 消息队列状态原值。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, device_id, device_type, gtm_msg_queue_status, pname_info
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_gtm_thdmsg
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, device_id LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>12. Insight 参数比对任务状态与基线</strong>——定位参数比对未执行或失败的任务。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT task_id, cluster_id, task_type, device_type, status, create_time, template_id FROM goldendb_insight.insight_param_comparison_task ORDER BY task_id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>13. Insight 参数配置或内存值不一致候选</strong>——找出配置值与内存值不一致的记录。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT task_id, param, type, consistency, memory_consistency, repeat_time, memory_repeat_time, create_time FROM goldendb_insight.insight_param_comparison_result WHERE consistency = 1 OR memory_consistency = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>14. Insight 巡检任务类型、目标范围与状态</strong>——区分实时、定时、历史范围巡检及任务状态。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT id, task_name, patrol_type, patrol_object, status, start_time, patrol_interval FROM goldendb_insight.insight_patrol_task ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>15. Insight 日志采集未完成与部分成功任务</strong>——对比计划节点数与成功/失败数。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT task_id, task_operate_status, collect_point_size, collect_success_size, collect_fail_size, create_time, end_time FROM goldendb_insight.insight_log_collect_task WHERE task_operate_status IN (1,2,3,4) LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>16. Insight 管理账号登录失败与锁解事件</strong>——排查管理面无法登录或任务无法发起。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT user_id, update_date, mod_type, m_trigger FROM goldendb_insight.insight_credential_user_log WHERE mod_type IN (1,2,4) ORDER BY update_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>17. Insight 组件升级编排任务状态</strong>——区分待执行、运行、成功与失败任务。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT task_id, upgrade_create_time, upgrade_start_time, upgrade_end_time, upgrade_version, upgrade_servertype, task_type, task_status, upgrade_batch, upgrade_progress FROM goldendb_insight.insight_upgrade_task ORDER BY task_id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>18. MDS 保存的表重分布容量参考</strong>——重分布前读取表在节点/组上的大小。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id,group_id,ip,master,table_name,table_size,insert_time FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_data_redistribute_tablesize_info WHERE table_name=:table_name ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :row_limit;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>19. MDS 告警事件及字典解释 Top 50</strong>——关联告警码、类型、等级、状态字典。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT a.id,a.systype,ty.sysdesc AS alarm_type,a.alarm_code,cd.alarm_desc,a.alarm_level,lv.level_desc,a.alarm_status,st.status_desc,a.alarm_source,a.alarm_time,a.recovery_time FROM goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_info AS a LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_code AS cd ON cd.alarm_code=a.alarm_code LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_status AS st ON st.status_code=a.alarm_status LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_level AS lv ON lv.alarm_level=a.alarm_level LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_systype AS ty ON ty.systype=a.systype ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>20. MDS 告警码、阈值与开关原值</strong>——盘点告警码目录及阈值、开关。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT c.systype,ty.sysdesc AS alarm_type,c.alarm_code,c.alarm_desc,c.alarm_level,lv.level_desc,c.threshold,c.isopen FROM goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_code AS c LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_level AS lv ON lv.alarm_level=c.alarm_level LEFT JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_systype AS ty ON ty.systype=c.systype ORDER BY c.systype,c.alarm_code LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>21. MDS 告警记录时间线</strong>——按短时间窗查看告警代码、级别、资源及清除时间。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT alarmid, code, almlevel, resourcetype, resourceid,
       createtime, updatetime, cleartime, maskflag
FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_alarming
WHERE createtime &gt;= :begin_time AND createtime &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY createtime DESC
LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>22. MDS 备份恢复等任务的组件步骤、重试和进度</strong>——定位未完成或失败组件。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT stream_no, task_id, task_type, component_type, task_redo_times, task_state, task_step, task_sub_step_total, task_sub_step_current, task_start_time, task_end_time, task_progress_percentage, is_total_progress FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_task_progress_detail WHERE task_state IN (1,2,4) LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>23. MDS 指定集群 DN 同步与 Relay 日志时延原值</strong>——定位复制追赶。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, group_id, device_id, device_type,
       group_switching, db_role,
       sync_log_delay_time, sync_log_gap,
       relay_log_delay_time, relay_log_gap
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_db_stat_delay_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, group_id, device_id
LIMIT 200
</code></pre>
<p><strong>24. MDS 指定集群状态与运行模式</strong>——读取集群模式、运行状态和最近元数据更新时间。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT CLUSTER_ID, CLUSTER_NAME, CLUSTER_MODE, CLUSTER_STATE, STATUS, WORK_MODEL, TIME_STAMP FROM mds.cluster_info WHERE CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>25. MDS 按分片记录的 UNDO 日志使用量</strong>——发现持续升高的分片。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, group_id, time_stamp, undo_log_size FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_undolog_size WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>26. MDS 按日聚合的告警状态与等级数量 Top 100</strong>——观察告警趋势。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT `aggretime`, `alarm_status`, `alarm_level`, `alarm_number`
FROM goldendb_insight.insight_alarm_info_day
ORDER BY `aggretime` DESC, `alarm_level`, `alarm_status`
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>27. MDS 登记的 Agent 与 OS 链路异常项</strong>——巡检连通性排查入口。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_type, device_ip_port, os_link_status, agent_link_status, create_time
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_agent_link_info
WHERE os_link_status IS NULL OR agent_link_status IS NULL
   OR os_link_status &lt;&gt; 1 OR agent_link_status &lt;&gt; 1
ORDER BY id LIMIT 50;
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="二容量与资源2834575871939496">二、容量与资源（28–34、57、58、71、93、94、96）</h2>
<p><strong>28. MDS 登记的主机目录容量与选用状态</strong>——发现数据目录容量压力。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT h.id AS host_id, h.host_name, h.status AS host_status, h.is_managed,
       d.dir_name, d.total_size AS total_mb, d.used_size AS used_mb,
       d.total_size - d.used_size AS free_mb,
       ROUND(100.0 * d.used_size / NULLIF(d.total_size, 0), 2) AS used_pct,
       d.is_selected, d.is_selected_data
FROM goldendb_insight.host_used_dir AS d
JOIN goldendb_insight.host_info AS h ON h.id = d.host_id
ORDER BY used_pct DESC, h.id, d.id
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>29. MDS 租户 DB 计划资源与安装状态</strong>——核对租户部署配置。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT tenancy_id, db_name, db_role, cpu_count, memory_capacity, disk_space, db_status FROM goldendb_insight.insight_tenancy_db_resource ORDER BY tenancy_id, db_name LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>30. MDS 聚合任务状态与最近执行时间</strong>——优先定位失败、停止中或长期运行的任务。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT id, task_id, cluster_id, task_name, task_name_type, task_type, task_status, task_source, oper_createtime, oper_last_executetime, oper_last_endtime FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_merge_task ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>31. MDS 资源类型与登记状态分布</strong>——发现资源模型登记异常。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT d.entrid AS resource_type_id, t.type_name, d.entstatus, COUNT(*) AS resource_count FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_device_info_dbmanage d LEFT JOIN goldendb_omm.gdb_device_typeset t ON d.entrid = t.type_id GROUP BY d.entrid, t.type_name, d.entstatus ORDER BY resource_count DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>32. MDS 通用管理任务与错误码</strong>——查看指定集群最近全局任务状态与时间线。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT task_id, cluster_id, task_type, start_timestamp,
       end_timestamp, err_code, oper_last_executetime
FROM (SELECT task_id, cluster_id, task_type, start_timestamp,
             end_timestamp, err_code, oper_last_executetime
      FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_common_task_info
      ORDER BY task_id DESC LIMIT 200) AS recent
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY task_id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>33. MDS 集群与 Proxy 绑定状态及运行状态</strong>——定位异常绑定或待完成操作。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT b.cluster_id, c.cluster_name, c.cluster_state,
       b.proxy_id, p.proxy_name, p.proxy_status, p.proxy_operation,
       b.status AS bind_status, b.create_stamp
FROM mds.cluster_proxy_bind_info AS b
LEFT JOIN mds.cluster_info AS c ON c.cluster_id = b.cluster_id
LEFT JOIN mds.proxy_info AS p ON p.proxy_id = b.proxy_id
ORDER BY b.status DESC, b.cluster_id, b.proxy_id
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>34. MDS 集群分片目录日空间增长原值 Top 100</strong>——排查哪个分片或目录容量变化值得核对。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT `aggretime`, `clusterId`, `clusterName`, `groupName`, `name`, `type`, `dirType`,
       `dataTotal`, `dataAvailable`, `dataUsed`, `dataIncreased`, `dayIncreased`
FROM goldendb_insight.insight_dbspace_increase_day
WHERE `clusterId` = :cluster_id
ORDER BY `aggretime` DESC
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>57. 分区和子分区定义、边界与估算容量</strong>——配合估算容量定位倾斜。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,PARTITION_NAME,SUBPARTITION_NAME,PARTITION_ORDINAL_POSITION,SUBPARTITION_ORDINAL_POSITION,PARTITION_METHOD,SUBPARTITION_METHOD,PARTITION_EXPRESSION,SUBPARTITION_EXPRESSION,PARTITION_DESCRIPTION,TABLE_ROWS,DATA_LENGTH,INDEX_LENGTH FROM information_schema.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=:schema_name AND TABLE_NAME=:table_name ORDER BY PARTITION_ORDINAL_POSITION,SUBPARTITION_ORDINAL_POSITION;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>58. 分片热点更新表的读写次数采样排行</strong>——定位写入集中对象。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, group_id, table_name, time_stamp, read_count, write_count, insert_count, update_count, delete_count FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_db_hotupdate_info WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY write_count DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>71. 指定租户的临时表空间文件采样 Top 50</strong>——定位临时空间占用节点与分片。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, device_id, device_type, group_id, file_name, file_size FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_tmptablespace_size WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY file_size DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>93. 数据库内统计估计行数 Top</strong>——以元数据估计行数排序大表，不扫描业务数据。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,ENGINE,TABLE_ROWS,CREATE_TIME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=:schema_name AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' AND TABLE_ROWS IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TABLE_ROWS DESC,TABLE_NAME LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>94. 数据库内表容量估计 Top</strong>——列出最大表及其表、索引大小。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_NAME,ENGINE,TABLE_ROWS,DATA_LENGTH,INDEX_LENGTH,DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH AS TOTAL_BYTES,DATA_FREE FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=:schema_name AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' ORDER BY TOTAL_BYTES DESC,TABLE_NAME LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>96. 新版 MDS DN 磁盘容量限额与满额策略</strong>——核对数据目录容量保护配置。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT id, resource_type, component_type, directory_type, capacity_quota_type, nominal_capacity_quota, capacity_full_policy, disk_desc, time_stamp FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_dn_disk_metadata ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="三权限与安全3546107">三、权限与安全（35–46、107）</h2>
<p><strong>35. MySQL/系统租户全局授权</strong>——检查高权限账号。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE_TYPE, IS_GRANTABLE FROM information_schema.USER_PRIVILEGES ORDER BY GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE_TYPE;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>36. MySQL/系统租户列级授权</strong>——补足表级授权核查。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT GRANTEE, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, PRIVILEGE_TYPE, IS_GRANTABLE FROM information_schema.COLUMN_PRIVILEGES ORDER BY GRANTEE, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, PRIVILEGE_TYPE;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>37. MySQL/系统租户库级授权</strong>——排查访问不足或过宽授权。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT GRANTEE, TABLE_SCHEMA, PRIVILEGE_TYPE, IS_GRANTABLE FROM information_schema.SCHEMA_PRIVILEGES ORDER BY GRANTEE, TABLE_SCHEMA, PRIVILEGE_TYPE;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>38. MySQL/系统租户表级授权</strong>——对象级授权核查。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT GRANTEE, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, PRIVILEGE_TYPE, IS_GRANTABLE FROM information_schema.TABLE_PRIVILEGES ORDER BY GRANTEE, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, PRIVILEGE_TYPE;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>39. MySQL/系统租户角色授予关系</strong>——建立角色继承链入口。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT FROM_USER, FROM_HOST, TO_USER, TO_HOST, WITH_ADMIN_OPTION FROM mysql.role_edges ORDER BY TO_USER, TO_HOST, FROM_USER, FROM_HOST;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>40. MySQL/系统租户账号及角色状态</strong>——定位登录及权限问题。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT User, Host, account_locked, password_expired, is_role, plugin, profile_name FROM mysql.user ORDER BY User, Host;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>41. MySQL/系统租户默认角色</strong>——排查已授予但未默认启用的问题。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT USER, HOST, DEFAULT_ROLE_USER, DEFAULT_ROLE_HOST FROM mysql.default_roles ORDER BY USER, HOST, DEFAULT_ROLE_USER;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>42. Oracle 兼容租户直接列级授权</strong>——定位细粒度访问。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT GRANTEE, OWNER, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, PRIVILEGE, GRANTABLE FROM sys.DBA_COL_PRIVS ORDER BY GRANTEE, OWNER, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, PRIVILEGE;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>43. Oracle 兼容租户直接对象授权</strong>——核对对象级授权。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT GRANTEE, OWNER, TABLE_NAME, PRIVILEGE, GRANTABLE FROM sys.DBA_TAB_PRIVS ORDER BY GRANTEE, OWNER, TABLE_NAME, PRIVILEGE;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>44. Oracle 兼容租户直接系统权限</strong>——检查过宽授权。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE, ADMIN_OPTION FROM sys.DBA_SYS_PRIVS ORDER BY GRANTEE, PRIVILEGE;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>45. Oracle 兼容租户直接角色授权</strong>——检查角色链。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT GRANTEE, GRANTED_ROLE, ADMIN_OPTION, DEFAULT_ROLE FROM sys.DBA_ROLE_PRIVS ORDER BY GRANTEE, GRANTED_ROLE;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>46. Oracle 兼容租户账号状态</strong>——查看锁定、到期时间与认证方式。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT USERNAME, ACCOUNT_STATUS, LOCK_DATE, EXPIRY_DATE, CREATED, AUTHENTICATION_TYPE FROM sys.DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>107. 近期修改的存储例程</strong>——发现近期创建或修改的过程/函数。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT ROUTINE_SCHEMA,ROUTINE_NAME,ROUTINE_TYPE,CREATED,LAST_ALTERED,SQL_DATA_ACCESS,SECURITY_TYPE FROM information_schema.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA=:schema_name AND LAST_ALTERED&gt;=:begin_time AND LAST_ALTERED&lt;:end_time ORDER BY LAST_ALTERED DESC,ROUTINE_NAME LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>

<h2 id="四性能分析475659636768">四、性能分析（47–56、59–63、67、68）</h2>
<p><strong>47. Proxy 至 DB 连接数采样时间线</strong>——区分客户端侧和后端 DB 侧连接压力。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, db_id, dbType, connect_port, start_time, end_time, dblink, alive_dblink FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_stat_proxy_db WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND end_time &gt;= :begin_time AND end_time &lt; :end_time ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>48. Proxy 至客户端连接数采样时间线</strong>——定位特定组件连接变化。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT device_id, device_type, connect_port, time_stamp, link, alive_drdc_link FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_stat_proxy_drdc WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>49. Proxy 连接端口锁超时次数</strong>——与 DN 等待及业务错误对时。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, proxy_id, device_id, connect_port, start_time, end_time, lock_num
FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_stat_connport_lock
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id AND start_time &gt;= :begin_time AND start_time &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY start_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>50. 业务入口事务事件累计耗时</strong>——按事务事件汇总执行次数与耗时。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT EVENT_NAME, COUNT_STAR, COUNT_READ_WRITE, COUNT_READ_ONLY, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000000,3) TOTAL_S, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1000000000000,6) AVG_S FROM performance_schema.events_transactions_summary_global_by_event_name ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC
</code></pre>
<p><strong>51. 业务入口当前内存分配热点 Top 20</strong>——定位内存占用热点。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT EVENT_NAME, CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED, HIGH_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED, COUNT_ALLOC, COUNT_FREE FROM performance_schema.memory_summary_global_by_event_name WHERE CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED &gt; 0 ORDER BY CURRENT_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_USED DESC LIMIT 20
</code></pre>
<p><strong>52. 业务入口待获取元数据锁</strong>——定位 DDL 或对象访问卡住的对象。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, LOCK_TYPE, LOCK_DURATION, LOCK_STATUS, OWNER_THREAD_ID FROM performance_schema.metadata_locks WHERE LOCK_STATUS = 'PENDING' LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>53. 业务入口慢 SQL 摘要累计统计</strong>——复核高开销 SQL。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT SCHEMA_NAME, DIGEST, DIGEST_TEXT, SUM_NUMS, SUM_QUERY_TIME, SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED, LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_slow_query_summary_by_digest WHERE DIGEST = :digest;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>54. 业务入口数据锁等待双方</strong>——为后续锁对象回读提供键。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT ENGINE, REQUESTING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID, REQUESTING_THREAD_ID, REQUESTING_ENGINE_LOCK_ID, BLOCKING_ENGINE_TRANSACTION_ID, BLOCKING_THREAD_ID, BLOCKING_ENGINE_LOCK_ID FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>55. 业务入口文件 I/O 等待与吞吐 Top 20</strong>——排查文件 I/O 热点。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT EVENT_NAME, COUNT_READ, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_READ/1000000000000,3) READ_WAIT_S, SUM_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_READ, COUNT_WRITE, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WRITE/1000000000000,3) WRITE_WAIT_S, SUM_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_WRITE FROM performance_schema.file_summary_by_event_name ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_READ + SUM_TIMER_WRITE DESC LIMIT 20
</code></pre>
<p><strong>56. 业务入口累计错误码 Top 20</strong>——定位高频错误。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT ERROR_NUMBER, ERROR_NAME, SQL_STATE, SUM_ERROR_RAISED, SUM_ERROR_HANDLED, FIRST_SEEN, LAST_SEEN FROM performance_schema.events_errors_summary_global_by_error WHERE SUM_ERROR_RAISED &gt; 0 ORDER BY SUM_ERROR_RAISED DESC LIMIT 20
</code></pre>
<p><strong>59. 可疑 SQL 采集规则启用状态与阈值配置</strong>——排查规则未启用或阈值不符预期。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT type_id, device_type, suspicioussql_type,
       `level`, `threshold`, threshold_desc, is_collect
FROM goldendb_insight.insight_suspicioussql_threshold
ORDER BY `level` DESC, type_id
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>60. 已确认分片路由视图查询形态</strong>——核对表的分片路由结构。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT TABLE_NAME,
       OWNER,
       DIST_TYPE,
       DIST_KEY,
       DIST_GROUPS,
       SHARDED,
       PARTITIONED,
       STATUS
FROM _gdb_sysdb._GDB_DBA_TABLES
WHERE OWNER = :owner
  AND TABLE_NAME = :table_name
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>61. 当前 InnoDB 并发与长事务</strong>——取活动事务、等待状态及修改规模。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT trx_id,trx_state,trx_started,trx_wait_started,trx_mysql_thread_id,trx_tables_locked,trx_lock_structs,trx_rows_locked,trx_rows_modified FROM information_schema.innodb_trx WHERE trx_started&lt;DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL :min_minutes MINUTE) ORDER BY trx_started;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>62. 当前会话明细与维度计数</strong>——列出全部用户/工作会话及按维度计数。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT a.server_name, a.session_id, a.program_name, a.user_name,
       a.session_state, a.wait_event,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS session_total,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.server_name) AS server_session_count,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.program_name) AS program_session_count,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.user_name) AS user_session_count,
       CASE WHEN a.wait_event IS NOT NULL THEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.wait_event) ELSE 0 END AS wait_event_session_count
FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(s.INST_ID) AS server_name,
       s.SID AS session_id,
       COALESCE(s.MODULE, s.PROGRAM) AS program_name,
       s.USERNAME AS user_name,
       s.STATUS AS session_state,
       CASE WHEN s.STATE = 'WAITING' AND s.WAIT_CLASS &lt;&gt; 'Idle' THEN s.EVENT END AS wait_event
      FROM sys.gv$session s
      WHERE s.TYPE = 'USER') a
ORDER BY a.server_name, a.session_id
</code></pre>
<p><strong>63. 当前活跃会话明细与维度计数</strong>——仅统计工作会话。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT a.server_name, a.session_id, a.program_name, a.user_name,
       a.session_state, a.wait_event,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS active_session_total,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.server_name) AS server_active_count,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.program_name) AS program_active_count,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.user_name) AS user_active_count,
       CASE WHEN a.wait_event IS NOT NULL THEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.wait_event) ELSE 0 END AS wait_event_session_count
FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(s.INST_ID) AS server_name,
       s.SID AS session_id,
       COALESCE(s.MODULE, s.PROGRAM) AS program_name,
       s.USERNAME AS user_name,
       s.STATUS AS session_state,
       CASE WHEN s.STATE = 'WAITING' AND s.WAIT_CLASS &lt;&gt; 'Idle' THEN s.EVENT END AS wait_event
      FROM sys.gv$session s
      WHERE s.TYPE = 'USER' AND s.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') a
ORDER BY a.server_name, a.session_id
</code></pre>
<p><strong>67. 指定主机的 CPU、内存和 I/O 历史采样</strong>——定位主机资源瓶颈时段。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, cpu_used, cpu_time_rate, mem_used_percentage, mem_used_size, mem_total_size, io_util, io_wait, used_ratio, swap_used_percentage FROM goldendb_insight.hostdynamic_info WHERE ip = :host_ip AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time ORDER BY time_stamp DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>68. 指定入口当前连接与 SQL 状态</strong>——按连接 ID 定位会话状态与当前 SQL。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT ID, USER, HOST, DB, COMMAND, TIME, STATE, DIGEST FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE ID = :session_id;
</code></pre>

<h2 id="五备份恢复646669818586">五、备份恢复（64–66、69、81、85、86）</h2>
<p><strong>64. 指定 Binlog 备份任务的节点结果</strong>——定位局部失败或漏分片。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT task_id, cluster_id, group_id, db_id, db_role,
       start_time, stop_time, binlog_file_nums,
       binlog_file_size_total, result, result_desc
FROM backup_restore.binlog_backup_task_info_detail
WHERE task_id = :task_id
ORDER BY group_id, db_id
LIMIT 200
</code></pre>
<p><strong>65. 指定 MDS 集群 Binlog 备份任务时间线</strong>——读取备份任务与结果码。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT schedule_number, task_id, cluster_id, task_type,
       start_time, stop_time, backup_strategy, result
FROM backup_restore.binlog_backup_task_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND start_time &gt;= :begin_time AND start_time &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>66. 指定 MDS 集群定时备份计划</strong>——读取周期、重试、Binlog 选项和状态。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, backup_start_time, backup_week_strategy,
       force_backup_master, backup_retry_interval, backup_retry_times,
       time_stamp, status, validity, backup_binlog
FROM mds.timing_backup_task_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC
LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>69. 指定备份的节点明细与错误</strong>——核对各节点错误和文件大小。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT d.BACKUP_ID, d.GROUP_ID, d.DB_NAME, d.IS_MASTER, d.START_TIMESTAMP, d.END_TIMESTAMP, d.ERR_CODE, d.ERR_DESC, d.BACKUP_FILE_SIZE FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_cluster_backup_history h JOIN goldendb_omm.gdb_cluster_backup_history_detail d ON d.BACKUP_ID = h.BACKUP_ID WHERE h.CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id ORDER BY d.BACKUP_ID DESC LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>81. 指定集群备份历史与结果</strong>——复核失败或遗漏的备份批次。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT BACKUP_ID, CLUSTER_ID, CLUSTER_NAME, BACKUP_TYPE, BACKUP_MODE, START_TIMESTAMP, END_TIMESTAMP, RESULT_CODE, RESULT_DESC FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_cluster_backup_history WHERE CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id ORDER BY BACKUP_ID DESC LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>85. 指定集群快照任务与操作结果</strong>——定位快照阶段的失败或积压。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT CLUSTER_ID, TASK_ID, SNAPSHOT_ID, SNAPSHOT_OPER, SNAPSHOT_OPER_TIME, SNAPSHOT_OPER_RESULT, SNAPSHOT_OPER_RESULT_DESC FROM backup_restore.snapshot_task_info WHERE CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id ORDER BY SNAPSHOT_OPER_TIME DESC LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>86. 指定集群最近恢复任务与错误码</strong>——回查恢复任务阶段时间和错误码。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT id, restore_type, backup_cluster_id, restore_cluster_id,
       is_check_binlog, is_active_rollback, restore_time,
       start_time, end_time, err_code, restore_mode
FROM (SELECT id, restore_type, backup_cluster_id, restore_cluster_id,
             is_check_binlog, is_active_rollback, restore_time,
             start_time, end_time, err_code, restore_mode
      FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_cluster_restore_task_info
      ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200) AS recent
WHERE restore_cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>

<h2 id="六故障处理与事务7280828487929597108">六、故障处理与事务（72–80、82–84、87–92、95、97–108）</h2>
<p><strong>70. 指定对象字段校验</strong>——返回字段名、类型、可空性。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT table_schema,
       table_name,
       ordinal_position,
       column_name,
       data_type,
       is_nullable
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = :schema_name
  AND table_name = :table_name
ORDER BY ordinal_position;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>72. 指定表分布方式与分片键</strong>——核对多分片表的路由结构。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT OWNER,
       TABLE_OWNER,
       TABLE_NAME,
       OBJECT_TYPE,
       DIST_TYPE,
       DIST_KEY,
       DIST_GROUPS
FROM _gdb_sysdb._gdb_dictionary_systb_info
WHERE OBJECT_TYPE = 'TABLE'
  AND TABLE_OWNER = UPPER(:database_name)
  AND TABLE_NAME = UPPER(:table_name)
ORDER BY TABLE_OWNER, TABLE_NAME
LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>73. 指定表基础属性与完整列类型</strong>——核对字符集、默认值、自增或生成列。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT t.TABLE_SCHEMA,t.TABLE_NAME,t.ENGINE,t.TABLE_COLLATION,t.CREATE_OPTIONS,c.ORDINAL_POSITION,c.COLUMN_NAME,c.COLUMN_TYPE,c.IS_NULLABLE,c.COLUMN_DEFAULT,c.EXTRA,c.COLUMN_COMMENT FROM information_schema.TABLES t JOIN information_schema.COLUMNS c ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA=t.TABLE_SCHEMA AND c.TABLE_NAME=t.TABLE_NAME WHERE t.TABLE_SCHEMA=:schema_name AND t.TABLE_NAME=:table_name ORDER BY c.ORDINAL_POSITION;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>74. 指定表字段结构</strong>——返回字段、类型、键、默认值与注释。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT ordinal_position,
       column_name,
       column_type,
       is_nullable,
       column_default,
       column_key,
       extra,
       column_comment
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = :database_name
  AND table_name = :table_name
ORDER BY ordinal_position;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>75. 指定表索引与基数</strong>——核对索引可用性与基数。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT index_name,
       non_unique,
       seq_in_index,
       column_name,
       cardinality,
       index_type
FROM information_schema.statistics
WHERE table_schema = :database_name
  AND table_name = :table_name
ORDER BY index_name, seq_in_index;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>76. 指定表约束</strong>——核对约束类型。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT constraint_name,
       constraint_type
FROM information_schema.table_constraints
WHERE table_schema = :database_name
  AND table_name = :table_name
ORDER BY constraint_type, constraint_name;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>77. 指定重分布任务的分区阶段</strong>——核对分区级源组、目标组、阶段与状态。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT ID, taskid, clusterid, origin_table_name, partition_name,
       src_group_id, dst_group_id, stage, status, file_row_number
FROM mds.redistribution_partition_info
WHERE taskid = :task_id
ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>78. 指定集群 GTID 回滚状态与重试次数</strong>——查看回滚记录与重试情况。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, gtid, proxy_id, flag, rollback_count, first_report_time, last_rollback_time, update_time
FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_gtid_rollback_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY rollback_count DESC, gtid LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>79. 指定集群 Proxy 连接实例当前连接数</strong>——定位连接负载异常候选入口。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT c.cluster_id, c.conn_instance_id, c.conn_instance_name,
       c.proxy_port, c.max_conn, c.status AS instance_status,
       p.proxy_id, p.pool_num, p.connect_num,
       p.curr_connections, p.status AS proxy_binding_status,
       p.time_stamp
FROM mds.conn_instance_info AS c
JOIN mds.proxy_instance_info AS p
  ON p.conn_instance_id = c.conn_instance_id
WHERE c.cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY p.curr_connections DESC, c.conn_instance_id, p.proxy_id
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>80. 指定集群作业执行结果时间线</strong>——追踪作业失败。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, job_id, job_name, job_type,
       start_time, end_time, result_code
FROM mds.gdb_job_result
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND start_time &gt;= :begin_time AND start_time &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY start_time DESC, job_id DESC
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>82. 指定集群字典对象删除历史</strong>——追查近期对象消失或 DDL 后异常。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, id, dict_version, name, type,
       `timestamp` AS drop_time
FROM mds.drop_dict_obj_history
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND `timestamp` &gt;= :begin_time AND `timestamp` &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY `timestamp` DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>83. 指定集群定时作业配置及失败计数</strong>——发现停调度或持续失败的作业。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, job_id, job_name, job_type, job_schema,
       sched_enable, job_broken, activated, failures,
       last_date, this_date, next_date, exec_timeout
FROM mds.gdb_jobs
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY failures DESC, job_id DESC
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>84. 指定集群巡检规则启用与配置表达式</strong>——定位监测范围和禁用规则。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT c.clusterId AS cluster_id, c.device_type, c.patrol_id,
       p.chinese_desc AS rule_name, p.patrol_object,
       p.patrol_apply AS template_enabled,
       c.patrol_apply AS cluster_enabled,
       c.patrol_relation AS cluster_rule_expression,
       p.support_range, p.display_type
FROM goldendb_insight.insight_cluster_patrolconfig AS c
JOIN goldendb_insight.insight_patrol_config AS p
  ON p.patrol_id = c.patrol_id AND p.device_type = c.device_type
WHERE c.clusterId = :cluster_id
ORDER BY c.device_type, c.patrol_id
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>87. 指定集群滚动升级任务状态</strong>——定位中断步骤。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT task_id, cluster_name, dbgroup, upgrade_type,
       progress, status, result_desc
FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_serversupgrade_task
WHERE cluster_name = :cluster_name
ORDER BY task_id DESC
LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
<p><strong>88. 指定集群管理操作时间线</strong>——回看 MDS 可见的管理操作。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, id, request_type, req_source,
       proxy_id, request_time, resp_time, status
FROM mds.opera_record
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND request_time &gt;= :begin_time AND request_time &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY request_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>89. 指定集群近期分布式死锁</strong>——关联请求和阻塞 GTID。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT CLUSTER_ID, GROUP_ID, TIME_STAMP, REQ_GTID, BLK_GTID, BLK_TRX_ID, AUTO_UNLOCK FROM goldendb_statistic.gdb_distributed_deadlock_info WHERE CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id AND TIME_STAMP &gt;= :begin_time AND TIME_STAMP &lt; :end_time ORDER BY TIME_STAMP DESC LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>90. 指定集群配置变更时间线</strong>——定位故障前后的配置变更记录。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, id, cfg_name, cfg_type, cfg_level,
       group_id, team_id, node_id, module_type, service_type,
       cfg_flag, update_time
FROM mds.cluster_config_history_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND update_time &gt;= :begin_time AND update_time &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>91. 指定集群高可用切换任务时间线</strong>——串联切换事件。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, group_id, task_id, task_type,
       start_time, room_id, result_code, result_desc
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_high_availability_task_info
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND start_time &gt;= :begin_time AND start_time &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY start_time DESC, task_id
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>92. 数据库一键修复任务历史</strong>——查看分片节点一键修复任务与结果。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_name, dbgroup, db_ip, db_port, status, progress, start_time_stamp, end_time_stamp, description
FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_autorecovery_history
WHERE cluster_name = :cluster_name
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>95. 新版 Insight AWR 报告维度与指标计算目录</strong>——解释报告指标与旧版字段差异。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT id, dimension_id, `head` AS metric_head,
       param_groupId AS metric_group_id,
       param_key, `calc` AS calc_method
FROM goldendb_insight.insight_awrreport_info
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 1000
</code></pre>
<p><strong>97. 旧版 Insight AWR 报告指标与计算方法目录</strong>——核对报告口径和字段映射。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT id, report_id AS report_topic_id,
       param_groupid AS snapshot_topic_id,
       `head` AS metric_head, `method` AS calc_method
FROM goldendb_insight.insight_awrreport_info
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 1000
</code></pre>
<p><strong>98. 旧版 MDS 指定主机磁盘 I/O 与时延采样</strong>——定位节点 I/O 瓶颈时间段。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, ip AS host_ip, disk_name,
       delay AS avg_latency_ms, delay_max AS max_latency_ms,
       r_await AS read_await_raw, w_await AS write_await_raw,
       readCount AS reads_per_sec, writeCount AS writes_per_sec,
       readKbSize AS read_kb_per_sec, writeKbSize AS write_kb_per_sec,
       usedRatio AS sampled_utilization
FROM goldendb_statistic.host_diskinfo
WHERE ip = :host_ip AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>99. 旧版 MDS 指定集群备机 I/O 与 SQL 线程状态</strong>——回看备机线程状态和复制延迟。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, group_id, device_id, device_type,
       seconds_behind_master, slave_io_running, slave_sql_running
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_slave_status
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, group_id, device_id
LIMIT 200
</code></pre>
<p><strong>100. 旧版 MDS 的 CN XA 与分布式事务异常采样</strong>——定位事务风险发生的节点与采样时间。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT time_stamp, cluster_id, device_id, device_type,
       xa_trans_num, xa_fail_num, xa_pending_num,
       distrans, distransabcommit, failtrans,
       crossnodediswtrans
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_cn_sqlstat
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC
LIMIT 100
</code></pre>
<p><strong>101. 旧版 MDS 的 Proxy 周期事务量与失败量</strong>——定位失败量或事务负载变化。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, device_id, device_type, connect_port,
       time_stamp, trans_num, trans_failed_num, trans_total_exectime
FROM goldendb_insight.gdb_stat_proxy_trans
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
  AND time_stamp &gt;= :begin_time AND time_stamp &lt; :end_time
ORDER BY time_stamp DESC, device_id
LIMIT 200
</code></pre>
<p><strong>102. 旧版 MDS 采集的 DN 会话历史</strong>——定位错误或等待集中时段。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT CLUSTER_ID, GROUP_ID, DEVICE_ID, CONNECT_PORT, TIME_STAMP, THREAD_ID, EVENT_ID, DIGEST, MYSQL_ERRNO, TIMER_WAIT, LOCK_TIME, ROWS_EXAMINED FROM goldendb_statistic.gdb_dn_sessionhistory_awr WHERE CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id AND TIME_STAMP &gt;= :begin_time AND TIME_STAMP &lt; :end_time ORDER BY TIME_STAMP DESC LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>103. 旧版 MDS 采集的 DN 复制延迟</strong>——按组、设备与源节点定位链路。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT CLUSTER_ID, GROUP_ID, DEVICE_ID, DEVICE_TYPE, CONNECT_PORT, ORIGINIPPORT, REPLICATIONDELAY, TIME_STAMP FROM goldendb_statistic.gdb_replication_delay WHERE CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id AND TIME_STAMP &gt;= :begin_time AND TIME_STAMP &lt; :end_time ORDER BY TIME_STAMP DESC LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>104. 旧版 MDS 采集的 DN 锁等待数量</strong>——定位锁等待热点节点。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT CLUSTER_ID, GROUP_ID, DEVICE_ID, DEVICE_TYPE, CONNECT_PORT, LOCK_WAIT_NUM, TIME_STAMP FROM goldendb_statistic.gdb_lock_wait WHERE CLUSTER_ID = :cluster_id AND TIME_STAMP &gt;= :begin_time AND TIME_STAMP &lt; :end_time ORDER BY TIME_STAMP DESC LIMIT :top_n;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>105. 最近参数下发、重启与回切任务状态</strong>——排查配置未生效和任务失败。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_id, task_id, task_type, strategy, issue_status, restart_status, switch_status, create_time, last_update_time FROM goldendb_insight.insight_paramissue_detail ORDER BY last_update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>106. 终止在线事务操作历史</strong>——回看终止事务操作、会话、GTID 与操作员。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT cluster_name, proxy_name, dialog_id, gt_id, kill_time, exec_result, operator
FROM goldendb_omm.gdb_kill_transaction_history
WHERE cluster_name = :cluster_name
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT :row_limit
</code></pre>
<p><strong>108. 重分布任务最新状态</strong>——查看指定集群最近重分布任务状态与时间线。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT task_id, cluster_id, task_state, state_description,
       task_create_time, task_end_time, type, time_stamp
FROM (SELECT task_id, cluster_id, task_state, state_description,
             task_create_time, task_end_time, type, time_stamp
      FROM mds.redistribution_task_info
      ORDER BY task_id DESC LIMIT 200) AS recent
WHERE cluster_id = :cluster_id
ORDER BY task_id DESC LIMIT 50
</code></pre>
